sloka: यज्ञवाटश्च सुमहान्गोमत्या नैमिशे वने ।आज्ञाप्यतां महाबाहो तद्धि पुण्यमनुत्तमम् ।। ७.९१.१५ ॥
transliteration: yajñavāṭaśca sumahāngomatyā naimiśe vane ।ājñāpyatāṁ mahābāho taddhi puṇyamanuttamam ।। 7.91.15 ॥

translations.english: O mighty-armed one, let a very large sacrificial enclosure be arranged in the Naimisha forest near the Gomati river, for that indeed is an unsurpassed meritorious act.
translations.hindi: ्रीरामचन्द्र जी उस उत्तम प्रकार से तप करनेवाले के पास जाकर कहने लगे-हे सुब्रत ! धन्य है तुमको
